verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Live API docs, which describe real-time voice and vision interaction with Gemini at low latency. That implies streaming-style delivery, but nothing here shows token-by-token text streaming or sub-second full answers, and 'low latency' is the extent of the latency documentation. Missing for 10: explicit streaming (e.g., stream generate-content) docs for text responses, documented latency figures or time-to-first-token behavior, evidence of sub-second responses, independent or hands-on corroboration.
